chart.title: Event Volume by Category and Result

search.query: index=black_beacon sourcetype=bb:scenario | eval event_series=event_category." / ".result | timechart span=5m count by event_series limit=20 useother=f

index=black_beacon sourcetype=bb:scenario event_category=identity event_action=login | stats count(eval(result="failure")) as failures count(eval(result="success")) as successes count as total_events by user src_ip | sort - failures - successes

index=black_beacon (sourcetype=bb:scenario OR sourcetype=bb:web) | rex field=_raw "^(?<nginx_src_ip>\S+)" | rex field=_raw "\"(?:GET|POST|HEAD)\s+(?<nginx_path>\S+)" | rex field=_raw "\"\s(?<nginx_status>\d{3})\s" | eval path=coalesce( if(event_category="web",resource,null()), nginx_path ) | eval source_ip=coalesce(src_ip,nginx_src_ip) | eval status_code=coalesce( nginx_status, if(event_category="web" AND result="failure","404",null()), if(event_category="web" AND result="success","200",null()) ) | where path IN ("/admin","/.env","/login","/api/export") | stats count as requests values(status_code) as status_codes values(sourcetype) as telemetry_source by source_ip path | sort - requests

index=black_beacon sourcetype=bb:scenario event_category=linux | where event_action IN ( "privileged_command", "account_created", "process_start", "archive_created" ) | table _time user host event_action application resource result severity | sort _time

index=black_beacon sourcetype=bb:scenario (event_category="cloud_application" OR event_category="repository_ci") | stats count as events values(event_action) as actions values(application) as applications values(resource) as resources values(result) as results values(severity) as severities by user | sort - events

table.title: Telemetry Risk by Host and User

search.query: index=black_beacon sourcetype=bb:scenario (severity="medium" OR severity="high" OR severity="critical") | eval risk_points=case( severity="critical",40, severity="high",25, severity="medium",10, 1=1,0 ) | stats sum(risk_points) as telemetry_risk count as notable_events values(event_action) as observed_actions values(severity) as severities by user host | eval risk_level=case( telemetry_risk>=90,"Critical", telemetry_risk>=60,"High", telemetry_risk>=30,"Medium", 1=1,"Low" ) | sort - telemetry_risk
